tools.name: find_tiktok_creators
tools.description: Find TikTok creators by keyword and return one row per creator: handle, bio, follower and like counts, plus any contact email, Instagram, YouTube or WhatsApp link the creator publishes. Billed to your Apify account at about $1 per 1,000 profiles.

tools.name: find_youtube_channel_emails
tools.description: Resolve the contact email behind YouTube channels, alongside their videos and Shorts with views, likes, tags and exact publish dates. One free contact row is returned per channel. Billed to your Apify account at about $1.50 per 1,000 videos.

tools.name: get_video_transcripts
tools.description: Get transcripts for TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, YouTube videos and Shorts, and X videos. Uses the platform's own subtitles when they exist and speech-to-text when they do not. Billed to your Apify account at about $2 per 1,000 subtitle transcripts ($5 per 1,000 speech-to-text ones).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_video_transcripts · Private data: find_tiktok_creators, find_youtube_channel_emails · Public sink: find_tiktok_creators, find_youtube_channel_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_video_transcripts · Private data: find_tiktok_creators, find_youtube_channel_emails · Public sink: find_tiktok_creators, find_youtube_channel_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
